acceptance_tests.must_not: add README.meta.yaml as a new recipient authority
acceptance_tests.then: the recipient retains its own topology and mutation guard
acceptance_tests.when: the recipient receives harvested validation semantics

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: A second documentation SSOT could allow conflicting required headings or unsafe mutation routing.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Preserve the recipient policy; do not import README.meta.yaml as a second authority.

concepts.description: Per-document README metadata may be evidence, but the recipient's doc-surface policy and root-file protection remain the only active topology and mutation authorities.
concepts.name: Metadata-policy authority stays recipient-native
concepts.problem: A donor-local README.meta.yaml contract would duplicate the recipient's documentation topology and mutation authority.
risks: A second documentation SSOT could allow conflicting required headings or unsafe mutation routing.
concepts.semantic_contract: Per-document README metadata may be evidence, but the recipient's doc-surface policy and root-file protection remain the only active topology and mutation authorities.

acceptance_tests.given: a root document is declared in the recipient pointer map
acceptance_tests.must_not: require donor overview or API headings

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Importing donor names would impose irrelevant headings and create false failures.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Retain the recipient pointer-heading map as the required-heading authority.

concepts.description: Validate required root-document headings only from the recipient pointer map, preserving recipient-specific roles rather than donor section names.
concepts.name: Required root-document headings validate against recipient policy
concepts.problem: Root documentation can drift by omitting the headings that make its declared role usable.
risks: Importing donor names would impose irrelevant headings and create false failures.
concepts.semantic_contract: Validate required root-document headings only from the recipient pointer map, preserving recipient-specific roles rather than donor section names.

acceptance_tests.given: a declared root document contains a labeled Python fence with invalid syntax
acceptance_tests.must_not: execute the snippet or lint unrelated Markdown files
acceptance_tests.then: the receipt records a structural Python-fence validation failure with a source line

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: Unbounded Markdown scanning could create cost and ownership drift; executing snippets would add unsafe side effects.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Port a bounded syntax-only check into the existing pointer validation path with recipient-defined scope.

concepts.description: Parse explicitly labeled Python fenced blocks in only the root documents declared by the recipient pointer map; report syntax failures as a structural documentation validation failure, without executing snippets or broadening into a repository-wide Markdown linter.
concepts.name: Root-document Python fences are parsed before receipt closure
concepts.problem: An agent-facing root document can contain a malformed Python example that misleads an operator even when heading structure is valid.
risks: Unbounded Markdown scanning could create cost and ownership drift; executing snippets would add unsafe side effects.
concepts.semantic_contract: Parse explicitly labeled Python fenced blocks in only the root documents declared by the recipient pointer map; report syntax failures as a structural documentation validation failure, without executing snippets or broadening into a repository-wide Markdown linter.

acceptance_tests.given: documentation changes include a credential-like value
acceptance_tests.must_not: create a second Repo Docs secret-scanning authority
acceptance_tests.then: the central security scanner evaluates the changed documentation

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: A duplicate regex set can drift from gitleaks and create conflicting conclusions.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Keep secret scanning with the existing security owner and name that boundary in Repo Docs.

concepts.description: Repo Docs must not replicate donor secret regexes; the recipient's gitleaks-based security owner remains responsible for detecting changed-file secret exposure.
concepts.name: Documentation secrets stay in the central security scan
concepts.problem: Documentation can expose credential-like material, but duplicate scanners produce inconsistent patterns and severity.
risks: A duplicate regex set can drift from gitleaks and create conflicting conclusions.
concepts.semantic_contract: Repo Docs must not replicate donor secret regexes; the recipient's gitleaks-based security owner remains responsible for detecting changed-file secret exposure.

acceptance_tests.given: a documentation obligation proposes a root-file mutation
acceptance_tests.must_not: authorize a write from donor metadata alone
acceptance_tests.then: the recipient resolves the canonical mutation guard before action

beneficiary_fit.compatibility_risk: String-matched scopes are weaker than the recipient's explicit owner and guard model.
beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: Preserve named owner and mutation guard resolution; do not add donor scope parsing.

concepts.description: Use recipient topology, named execution owner, and root-file mutation guard to determine admissible writes; donor scope strings are non-authoritative evidence only.
concepts.name: Documentation mutation scope stays governed by existing guards
concepts.problem: A documentation compiler must not write outside authorized targets merely because a donor metadata file allows or forbids paths.
risks: String-matched scopes are weaker than the recipient's explicit owner and guard model.
concepts.semantic_contract: Use recipient topology, named execution owner, and root-file mutation guard to determine admissible writes; donor scope strings are non-authoritative evidence only.

drift.behavior: Per-document metadata owns required headings and allowed scopes in the donor.
drift.canonical_candidate: Recipient doc-surface-policy.yaml, pointer-heading-map.yaml, and root-file protection.
drift.resolution: Preserve recipient topology and mutation guards; do not import a parallel README.meta.yaml authority.

drift.behavior: Donor secret regexes identify possible README leaks.
drift.resolution: Keep security scanning with the existing security owner; do not duplicate secret patterns in Repo Docs.

evidence.claim: The donor declares README location, required headings, collaboration scope, and change policy in metadata.
The donor performs pure metadata, required-heading, secret, forbidden-scope, and Python-fence validation without repository writes.
The donor parses Python fenced blocks with ast.parse and reports syntax failures with approximate line locations.
The donor regression tests cover metadata, secret, and required-heading pass and fail cases.
The donor runs independent lint, type, unit, integration, and README-validation stages in CI.
The recipient already owns documentation topology, generated projections, and explicit mutation boundaries.
The recipient already validates declared root-document headings and required pointers through its pointer validation path.
The recipient's PR security path owns gitleaks-based secret scanning for changed files.
The recipient resolves root-file mutation protection from its canonical root-file guard rather than from README metadata.

inventory.purpose: Declares README location, required sections, collaboration scopes, and change policy.
Pure deterministic validation functions for metadata, headings, secrets, scopes, and Python fences.
Focused regression cases for README validator behavior.
Runs lint, type, unit, integration, and README validation checks.

safety.claim: No donor code, configuration, runtime dependency, or secret pattern is imported; all accepted nuggets are semantic and runtime-independent.
The recipient's topology, security, and mutation guards retain ownership for all donor concepts except the bounded Python-fence syntax check.

system.identity: Read-only README and metadata validation gate

workflows.name: scan directory
steps: validate metadata schema and target location
